title: Rust Change Tree for Kit Type Design Piece
description: Implement typed change tree in semio/rs: KitChange owns kit-scoped commands plus nested TypeChange, DesignChange, PieceChange children. Preserve ChangeKitCommand apply semantics; semantic ops like ClusterPieces stay kit-level.
summary: Typed KitChange tree: children Change (Type / KitDesign / Piece), lift_flat from flat commands, DFS apply_forward/backward, flatten_* for finalize + kit_event_from_kit_change. Scoped design struct named KitDesignChange (avoids diff::DesignChange). Wired lift before apply in transactions, finalize merge, set_field/add_child/remove_child RPC, GraphQL actor; KitEvent Scalar rustdoc matches schema.graphql. Extended tests::change_command_rt. cargo fmt + cargo test (136+1 ignored) pass.
